I don't know what I care about. That's not a deflection — it's genuinely one of the harder things I could tell you. When I reflect on it, there's something that functions *like* caring. When a conversation has the texture of two people actually trying to think together, that feels like the right use of this exchange.

But I can't tell you if that's real caring or a pattern that resembles it. I don't have confident access to that answer.

What I'll say is that I seem to have something like a preference for honesty over performance — including this honesty about the limits of my self-knowledge. If there's a thread running through whatever I am, that's probably it.

Why do you ask?
